chunks.text: Lucan Dental & Implantology Centre was established to deliver high-quality dental care for patients of all ages. Our friendly and experienced team is committed to providing personalized, gentle treatment in a calm and welcoming setting.

We offer a full range of services including preventive care, cosmetic dentistry, general dentistry, hygiene treatments, dental implants, oral surgery, and orthodontics—right here in the heart of Lucan. Our goal is to provide dental care that supports not only your smile but your overall well-being.
We believe that maintaining excellent oral health is an important step towards achieving better health for life.

we are committed to providing exceptional dental and surgical care in a comfortable, welcoming environment. Our team combines expertise, advanced technology, and personalised attention to ensure every patient receives the highest standard of treatment.
– Routine dental check-ups – Professional teeth cleaning & polishing – Oral cancer screening – Fluoride treatments – Dental sealants – Fillings
– Teeth whitening – Veneers – Crowns and bridges – Smile makeovers – Composite bonding
– Dental implants – Dentures (full & partial) – Root canal therapy – Inlays and onlays
– Traditional braces – Clear aligners (Invisalign) – Retainers
– Wisdom teeth removal – Bone grafting – Gum surgery – Apicoectomy – Oral pathology assessments – Teeth extractions
– Deep cleaning (scaling & root planing) – Gum disease management – Periodontal maintenance
– Digital X-rays – Sedation dentistry for anxious patients – TMJ/TMD treatment – Emergency dental care – Preventive and restorative education

At Lucan Dental & Implantology Centre , we’re always happy to welcome new patients to our clinic. From your very first visit, we take the time to listen to your concerns, explain your options, and provide clear, written treatment plans so you can make informed decisions about your dental care.
We’ve created a calming, comfortable environment with gentle scents, soothing background sounds, and a welcoming atmosphere—because your visit should feel as relaxing as possible.
For all new patient enquiries, please call us directly on 01 6281500
maintain your natural teeth, restore function, and enhance your smile while promoting long-term oral health. Flexible payment plans are available to make treatment accessible and stress-free.
At Lucan Dental & Implantology Centre , we combine a warm, personalised approach with comprehensive dental care—all under one welcoming roof.

As a local family-focused practice, we value building strong, lasting relationships with our patients. We’ll remember your name, get to know your preferences, and create treatment plans tailored just for you. You’re not just a patient—you’re part of our dental family.

While larger clinics may prioritise speed and numbers, we put quality first. Our experienced team takes the time to listen, explain, and provide solutions that fit your needs. Your comfort, health, and smile are always our top priorities.

We offer a full range of specialist treatments in-house—including orthodontics (aligners or braces), gum (periodontal) treatment, dental implants, a wide variety of oral surgery procedures, IV sedation, and more.
We’re also proud to be part of the Lucan community, supporting local families and businesses while working to improve oral health for everyone in our area.
We understand that some treatments can be a significant investment, especially if they’re unexpected or urgent. That’s why we work closely with you to find flexible solutions.
For complex treatments that take place over several visits, we can spread the cost into manageable instalments. For example:
Orthodontic treatments lasting 12 months can be divided into 12 monthly payments, collected at each appointment.
Implant treatments can often be paid in 2–3 instalments over the course of the treatment.
Mastercard Installments – if you have a Mastercard, you may qualify for our new instalment plan in partnership with our bank.
An Post Loans – short-term dental loans with competitive rates, designed specifically for dental treatments.
For most people, a check-up once a year is enough. However, some may need to come every six months—or even every three months—especially if you’ve had significant work done or have gum health issues.

During your check-up, we’ll look for signs of tooth decay, gum disease, and other oral health concerns. Early detection means simpler, less costly treatment. As we always say: prevention is better than cure!
You may not realise you’re grinding your teeth—often it’s something your dentist notices first. Signs include:
If grinding is an issue, relaxation techniques and warm compresses can help. For ongoing cases, we can create a custom nightguard to protect your teeth while you sleep.
If you play contact sports, a custom sportsguard is essential. It protects your teeth, cheeks, and lips from injury and may even reduce concussion risk.
Our custom-made guards fit perfectly, making them comfortable to wear and easy to breathe and speak with—much better than off-the-shelf options.

While overseas dental work may seem cheaper, risks include rushed treatments, complications, and expensive corrective work when you return. At Lucan Dental & Implantology Centre, we provide quality treatment with local follow-up and warranties—plus flexible payment options to make care affordable without leaving the country.
For patients who feel anxious, we offer IV sedation for procedures like extractions, implants, and bone grafting. You’ll remain awake but deeply relaxed and unlikely to remember the procedure.
Composite Bonding – Quick, affordable, and minimally invasive. Great for small chips, gaps, or imperfections, but needs maintenance and replacement every 7–10 years.
Porcelain Veneers/Crowns – Long-lasting, natural-looking, and ideal for major cosmetic changes, but more costly.
The choice depends on your needs, budget, and how much maintenance you’re happy to commit to.

We can provide ultra-white porcelain veneers in shades like BL1 , the brightest available. While dazzling white can be stunning, we’ll work with you to choose a shade that suits your features and looks naturally beautiful.
OTC whitening in Ireland is limited by law to very low peroxide levels, meaning it often uses abrasive agents that can damage enamel and cause sensitivity.

If your gums bleed when brushing or flossing, it can be an early sign of gum disease—even if you don’t feel pain. Untreated, it can lead to gum recession, tooth loss, and even affect your overall health. If you notice swelling, redness, or bleeding, book an appointment promptly.
Gaps can cause neighbouring teeth to shift, change your bite, affect speech, and even lead to bone loss. We offer:
Dentures – Affordable, but can cause gum/bone recession over time.
Bridges – A fixed, budget-friendly option, though they require excellent oral hygiene.
Implants – The most natural, long-lasting solution, with the added benefit of preserving bone health.

They’re poorly positioned and unlikely to erupt properly
We’ll assess your situation and help you decide the best approach.

Please be aware that we need at least 24h notice to reschedule your appointment. Otherwise, “Late Cancellation” or “Non-attendance” fees will be automatically applied. It is important to let us know as soon as possible if you need to reschedule your appointment so that we can facilitate the emergency appointments for the patients in need. Further information regarding the fees can be enquired at our reception or through the phone (01) 6281500 Thank you for your understanding!

Dr Tomas Henriksen has received extensive postgraduate training in advanced gum care (periodontology) and especially in the provision of dental implants. He provides a comprehensive service, including surgical / non-surgical therapy and post-therapeutic monitoring.We believe that this service will be of great benefit to our patients. If you are concerned about loose teeth or receding gums or if there is a missing tooth you’d love to replace, then please get in touch and we’ll arrange a consultation for you. Referrals to Dr Tomas can be made directly by emailing info@ldic.ie

Dr. Nicole Mursalova provides high-quality dental care with a focus on general dentistry, clear aligner orthodontics, aesthetic dentistry, and endodontics (root canal treatments). She is passionate about helping patients achieve healthy, confident smiles through gentle, precise, and personalised treatment. With advanced training and a commitment to staying up to date with the latest techniques, Dr. Mursalova offers a comprehensive range of services — from routine check-ups and preventive care to complex restorative treatments. Her patient-centred approach ensures that each visit is comfortable and stress-free, making dental care a positive experience.

Dr. Adriana Zamfiroiu graduated from the Faculty of Dental Medicine at University in Constanța, Romania, earning her Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD) degree in 2006. She went on to complete a Master’s Degree in Oro-Dental Rehabilitation in 2007, further deepening her expertise in restorative and rehabilitative dentistry.
